blurb: The Shearwater Aviation Museum (SAM) is an accredited Canadian Forces Museum who's mission is to tell the story of Maritime Military Aviation at Canada's oldest operational military air base. With a specialty in naval aviation, the SAM collects aircraft that represents the operational history of the air station that is now 12 Wing
